title: Beelink joins, and an Omarchy Edition mini PC is planned
summary: Beelink pledges $100,000 a year for three years and is working with Omarchy on a mini PC that ships with it.

topics.angle: The newest name, taking the stated total to about $24 million.
Omarchy preinstalled on a machine you can buy.

claims.text: The pledge is $100,000 a year for three years.
A special Omarchy Edition mini PC is in the works. Price, specs and date are not given.

would_change: A product page, or a change of plan.
